fixes.title: Pre-flight error title 'No filter wheel for SmartExposure' is untrue — a filter wheel is connected; the body says the real cause
fixes.summary: Location confirmed exactly as reported: packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/rules/smart_exposure_rules.dart, SmartExposureFilterWheelMissingRule. The rule's only test was `profile.filterNames.isEmpty` — a property of the equipment PROFILE — yet it reported that result as a statement about HARDWARE ('No filter wheel for SmartExposure'), a fact it never read and that the Equipment screen actively contradicts. Fixed at the cause rather than by swapping one hard-coded string for another: the rule now reads `filterWheelStateProvider` (the same source the Equipment screen renders, already used by FilterInWheelRule in this package) plus the profile's own `filterWheelId`, and words the issue after what it actually observed. Wheel connected, or a wheel assigned in the profile -> title 'No filters configured for SmartExposure' and a description that names the connected wheel ('Simulated Filter Wheel is connected, but the active equipment profile "X" lists no filters, so its rows have nothing to select'), so the message reconciles with Equipment instead of sending the user there to check working hardware. Genuinely wheel-less rig -> the original 'No filter wheel for SmartExposure' title survives, because there it is true. The resolution hint now also echoes the slots the driver reports ('the wheel reports 3 slots: Slot 1, Slot 2, Slot 3') instead of asking the user to guess at their own hardware. Two smaller untruths in the same rule fixed alongside: the null-profile info issue said the 'filter-wheel requirement could not be verified' (it checks a filter list, not a wheel), and the class/file doc claimed the rule detects 'missing filter wheel on the active equipment profile'. Deliberately NOT changed: which runs get blocked. The gate is still `profile.filterNames.isEmpty` at the same ERROR severity — loosening it (e.g. accepting driver-reported names) would let a run start whose SmartExposure rows have nothing valid to select, which is the inversion this campaign was warned about.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_core/test/providers/sequence/rules/smart_exposure_rules_test.dart, new group 'SmartExposureFilterWheelMissingRule wording matches the rig' (5 tests) driving the real SmartExposureFilterWheelMissingRule.validate through a real Riverpod Ref/ValidationContext, with filterWheelStateProvider overridden by a stub notifier. Reproduces the reporter's exact rig (wheel connected + green, profile filter list empty) and asserts the issue the pre-flight panel renders: title is 'No filters configured for SmartExposure' and NOT 'No filter wheel', description names the connected wheel, hint lists the driver's slots. A companion test pins the genuinely wheel-less case to the old title so the fix cannot over-correct, and one more asserts a profile WITH filters still raises nothing, so the wording change provably did not widen or narrow which runs are blocked.
fixes.revert_check: Reverted the production wiring in smart_exposure_rules.dart: deleted the whole message-selection block (the `ctx.ref.read(filterWheelStateProvider)` read at :178 through the `title`/`cause`/`hint` if/else ending at :204) and restored the ValidationIssue to the pre-fix literals `title: 'No filter wheel for SmartExposure'` / description 'requires a filter wheel, but the active equipment profile has no filters configured.'. That is the call site, not logic hidden inside a helper — with it gone the rule can no longer consult the wheel at all. 3 of the 5 new tests failed: 'Expected: No filters configured for SmartExposure / Actual: No filter wheel for SmartExposure' (twice) and 'Expected: contains no filter wheel is connected / Actual: Smart Exposure "Smart Exposure" requires a filter wheel, but the active equipment profile has no filters configured.'. Restored; 19/19 in the file pass, 452/452 in packages/skotiq_core/test/providers/sequence/ pass, dart analyze clean, dart format clean.
fixes.caveats: The class is still named SmartExposureFilterWheelMissingRule and its `name` getter still returns 'SmartExposureFilterWheelMissing'. Neither is user-visible, and renaming would touch sequence_validation.dart plus a comment in skotiq_app while other agents are editing those files concurrently; the class doc now states plainly what the rule tests. One adjacent internal comment is still loosely worded — packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/widgets/smart_exposure_properties.dart:611 says 'No profile filter wheel' where it means 'no profile filters' — but the user-facing hint on that same widget ('Filter name (no profile filters)') is already accurate.
